narrative.title: The Frequency Band Charter
narrative.scenario: A spectrum monitor tallies how often each channel transmitted during a window, and the regulator chart lists the k busiest channels. Ties in traffic share the chart regardless of order, so the monitor only needs the correct set. A small shortlist evicts the quietest channel whenever a busier challenger arrives.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array nums and an integer k.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the k most frequent values of nums, in any order.
constraints: k is in the range [1, number of distinct values]
The answer set is guaranteed to be unique

testCases.explanation: Channel 1 fired three times, channel 2 twice — the two busiest.
One channel, one entry on the chart.

hintLevels: Level 1: Count first, select second — frequencies turn selection into a top-k problem.
Level 2: A min-heap of size k evicts the quietest channel; survivors form the chart.
Level 3: Ties make order ambiguous, so compare the result as a set when testing.
